description: WM-007 corpus: multilingual text and file-path retrieval with positive controls and hard negatives. Hand-written, not taken from any user store. `search` queries name the one applicable memory; `path` queries name the exact set forPath must return. Hard negatives (another session's private note, a superseded or deleted record, look-alike paths) must never be returned to the default viewer.
